import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Queue;

public class Main {

    static class Pos {
        int row, col;

        public Pos(int _row, int _col) {
            row = _row;
            col = _col;
        }
    }

    static int dr[] = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int dc[] = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int N, T;
    static char B1[] = new char[12 * 12];
    static char B2[] = new char[12 * 12];
    static char B[][] = new char[12][12];
    static int D1[][] = new int[12][12];
    static int D2[][] = new int[12][12];

    static class MaxFlow {
        int N;
        int bfs_par[] = new int[1000];
        int bfs_D[] = new int[1000];
        int flow[][] = new int[1000][1000];

        public MaxFlow(int _N) {
            N = _N;
        }

        public void add_edge(int u, int v, int _cap) {
            flow[u][v] += _cap;
        }

        public int augmenting_path_bfs(int src, int dst, int[] path, int mincap) {
            Arrays.fill(bfs_par, -1);
            Arrays.fill(bfs_D, -1);

            bfs_D[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            q.add(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                if (cur == dst) {
                    int cfp = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    path[bfs_D[dst]] = dst;
                    for (int curv = dst, k = bfs_D[dst] - 1; bfs_par[curv] >= 0; --k) {
                        int prev = bfs_par[curv];
                        cfp = Math.min(cfp, flow[prev][curv]);
                        curv = path[k] = prev;
                    }
                    return cfp;
                }
                for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
                    if (bfs_D[v] < 0 && flow[cur][v] - flow[dst][v] > mincap) {
                        bfs_D[v] = bfs_D[cur] + 1;
                        bfs_par[v] = cur;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public int dinic(int s, int t) {
            int res = 0;
            while (true) {
                int[] path = new int[1000];
                int cfp = augmenting_path_bfs(s, t, path, 0);
                if (cfp == 0)
                    break;
                for (int w = 0; w < N; ++w) {
                    if (bfs_D[w] >= 0 && flow[w][t] > 0) {
                        cfp = flow[w][t];
                        for (int curv = w, prev = bfs_par[w]; prev >= 0; curv = prev, prev = bfs_par[prev]) {
                            cfp = Math.min(cfp, flow[prev][curv]);
                        }
                        flow[w][t] -= cfp;
                        flow[t][w] += cfp;
                        for (int curv = w, prev = bfs_par[w]; prev >= 0; curv = prev, prev = bfs_par[prev]) {
                            flow[prev][curv] += cfp;
                            flow[curv][prev] -= cfp;
                        }
                        res += cfp;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        N = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        T = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);
        Arrays.fill(B1, '#');
        Arrays.fill(B2, '#');
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            input = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                B1[r * 12 + c] = input[c - 1].charAt(0);
                if (B1[r * 12 + c] != '#') {
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
            }
            B1[r * 12 + N + 1] = '#';
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            input = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                B2[r * 12 + c] = input[c - 1].charAt(0);
                if (B2[r * 12 + c] != '#') {
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
            }
            B2[r * 12 + N + 1] = '#';
        }
        List<Pos> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pos> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = new Pos(0, 0);
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B1[r * 12 + c])) {
                    if (B1[r * 12 + c] > '0') {
                        scientists.add(new Pos(r, c));
                    }
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (B1[r * 12 + c] == 'Z') {
                    z = new Pos(r, c);
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(B2[r * 12 + c]) && B2[r * 12 + c] > '0') {
                    capsules.add(new Pos(r, c));
                }
            }
        }
        bfs1(z);
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(scientists.size() + capsules.size() + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); ++i) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            mf.add_edge(0, i + 1, B1[s.row * 12 + s.col] - '0');
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); ++j) {
            Pos c = capsules.get(j);
            mf.add_edge(scientists.size() + j + 1, scientists.size() + capsules.size() + 1, B2[c.row * 12 + c.col] - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); ++i) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            bfs2(s);
            for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); ++j) {
                Pos c = capsules.get(j);
                if (D2[c.row][c.col] >= 0 && D2[c.row][c.col] <= T) {
                    mf.add_edge(i + 1, scientists.size() + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }
        int res = mf.dinic(0, scientists.size() + capsules.size() + 1);
        pw.println(res);
        pw.close();
    }

    static void bfs1(Pos src) {
        Arrays.fill(D1, -1);
        D1[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                Pos nxt = new Pos(cur.row + dr[k], cur.col + dc[k]);
                if (B[nxt.row][nxt.col] != '.') continue;
                if (D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] < 0) {
                    D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] = D1[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(Pos src) {
        Arrays.fill(D2, -1);
        D2[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            if (D1[cur.row][cur.col] >= 0 && D2[cur.row][cur.col] >= D1[cur.row][cur.col]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                Pos nxt = new Pos(cur.row + dr[k], cur.col + dc[k]);
                if (B[nxt.row][nxt.col] != '.') continue;
                if (D2[nxt.row][nxt.col] < 0) {
                    if (D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] >= 0 && D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] < D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1) continue;
                    D2[nxt.row][nxt.col] = D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
